label: base
desc: Check frame time at the Kokiri spawn and on the walk with default settings

label: async-wait
desc: Check frame time when Switch 2 draws wait for their pipeline instead of being dropped (native_async_draws Wait)

label: mesh-compute
desc: Check frame time with Switch 2 mesh shaders always emulated in compute (mesh_shaders Compute)

label: mesh-native
desc: Check frame time with Switch 2 mesh shaders always native in Metal (mesh_shaders Native)

label: no-mesh
desc: Check frame time with all mesh-shader draws skipped (EDEN_NX2_NO_MESH, diagnostic only)

label: gpu-high
desc: Check frame time with GPU accuracy High instead of Low

label: write-full
desc: Check frame time with compute writes marked in full (native_compute_write_mark Full)

label: lod0
desc: Check frame time with textures forced to their top mip (EDEN_NX2_FORCE_LOD0, diagnostic only)
